Money deposited in High Courts and unclaimed for twenty years transferred to Government

[THE UNCLAIMED DEPOSITS ACT, 1866]
[THE UNCLAIMED DEPOSITS ACT, 1866]
ACT No. XXV of 1866
[11th July, 1866]
An Act to transfer to the Government of (Subs. by A. O.,1949, Sch., for "India".)[Pakistan] certain
securities and moneys deposited in the (Subs. by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the
23rd March 1956), for "High Court of East Bengal" which had been
subs. for "High Courts of Judicature at Fort William, Madras and Bombay
" by A. O., 1949, Sch.) [High Court of East Pakistan] (The words "and the proceeds of certain estates in the
charge of the Administrator General of Bengal" were rep. by the
Administrator General's Act, 1867 (24 of 1867), and "and in the Supreme
Court of the Straits Settle ments were rep. by the Repealing Act, 1874 (16 of
1874), s. 2 and Sch., Pt. I.)* * *.
1. Money deposited in High Courts and unclaimed for
twenty years transferred to Government. All
securities and sums of money (Ins. by A.O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., (with effect from the
23rd March, 1956).)
[deposited as aforesaid in the High Court of East Pakistan in the courts of
suits in that Court or] deposited (Subs. by A. O., 1949 Sch. for "in the said High Courts *
* * or any of them, in the course of suits in any of the said Courts or of the
late Sup reme Courts of Calcutta, Madras and Bombay".) [in or transferred as aforesaid to
the High Court of East Bengal in the course of suits in that Court or in the
High Court at Calcutta], and now or hereafter appearing to have been in such
deposit for a period of twenty years or upwards, without any claim thereto
having been made and allowed during that period, shall be transferred and paid
to (The
original words "the G. of I. for the general purposes of Govern ment"
have successively been amended by A. O., 1937, A. O 1949, Sch., and A. O.,
1961, Art. 2 (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956), to read as above.) [the Government of East Pakistan].

3. Transfer not made pending suits. Nothing in this Act shall authorize any transfer or pay ment of any
such securities, sums of money or proceeds as afore said, pending any suit
already instituted or which shall hereafter be instituted in respect thereof.
